newsitem.title: USA: Techs resists late selloff, Nasdaq hits new high.
newsitem.headline: Techs resists late selloff, Nasdaq hits new high.

text.p: Nasdaq shares wavered in late trading, but strength in large-capitalization technology stocks pushed over-the-counter issues to a third consecutive record high.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 3.12 points or 0.21 percent to close unofficially at 1470.73, which tops Thursday's record close of 1467.61. The Dow industrials lost 37 points to close unofficially at 7858.
"There's was some softness late in the day, but the big name techs held firm and didn't get sucked into the selloff that brought the Dow down," one trader said.

Cisco Systems Inc, Intel Corp, Dell Computer Corp and 3Com Corp each posted gains. But the session was mixed overall, with declining issues beating advancers 2235 to 2098 on total volume of 552 million shares.

Jones Medical Industries Inc, the most active Nasdaq issue, lost 15-1/2 to 27-7/8 after it said its second quarter earnings will likely fall short of analysts' estimates. Atlas Air Inc lost 2-1/8 to 31 after the air cargo company said its quarterly results would be below Wall Street expectations.
